name: aira-cli
description: Terminal interface for AIRA. Talks to the existing desktop multi-agent app through its own on-disk hive (registry, fleet, tasks, messages) — it does not replace or modify the Electron application.

scripts.build: node --check bin/aira.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/sys.js && node --check src/dispatch.js && node --check src/commands.js
